definitions.gloss: shellfish gathering; clamming; digging for clams at low tide
definitions.explanation: A popular recreational activity in Japan, typically done in spring, where people gather clams and other shellfish on tidal flats during low tide.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{潮干狩|しおひが}りに{行|い}く。
examples.english: We go clamming when spring comes.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{潮干狩|しおひが}りを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed shellfish gathering as a family.

examples.japanese: ゴールデンウィークは{潮干狩|しおひが}りのシーズンで、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{干潟|ひがた}を{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Golden Week is clamming season, and many people visit the tidal flats.

notes: A seasonal spring activity popular with families, especially during Golden Week (late April to early May). The main target is あさり (short-necked clam). Famous spots include {千葉|ちば}{県|けん} and {愛知|あいち}{県|けん} coastal areas. The word combines {潮干|しおひ} (ebb tide) with {狩|か}り (hunting/gathering). Related: {干潟|ひがた} (tidal flat), {大潮|おおしお} (spring tide — the best time for clamming).
